products.name: Baichuan
products.note: Chinese open-source LLM; medical and legal fine-tunes; cross-border data review advised

profile_text.body:
Baichuan AI is a Chinese artificial intelligence company whose stated mission is to help the general public easily and affordably access world knowledge and professional services. The company describes itself as dedicated to building China's best large-model foundation through breakthroughs in language AI.

The company's primary product is Baichuan, a Chinese open-source large language model that includes fine-tuned variants for medical and legal applications. Users working across borders are advised to review data handling considerations when using the model.

No litigation, regulatory filings, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the available facts for this company.
